items.title: Inventory root-level documentation and classify target homes
items.context: List root Markdown documents, separate entrypoint/compatibility files from requirements decisions, guides, notes, and archive candidates. Keep the output scoped to a migration guide so unrelated Layer4 runtime changes are not touched.
items.userSees: The migration guide contains a table listing all root Markdown files and classifies each as stay-root, move-to-decision, move-to-guide, note/archive, or future compatibility work.

happy.desc: Guide lists every current root Markdown file found by root-level Markdown inventory and assigns a target-home classification.

edge.desc: Host entrypoint files including README.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and KOALA.md are not prescribed for blind relocation and remain discoverable from root until a separate compatibility story changes them.

adversarial.desc: Guide does not import unrelated Layer4 or Production Safety runtime claims and does not treat untracked or dirty docs as completed migrations.

verificationEvidence.command: node inline root inventory + NAV + target strict checker
verificationEvidence.note: Fresh strict checker at current material HEAD passed: rootDocCount=17, inventoryRows=17, missingRoot=[], extraRoot=[]; guide inventory covers every root Markdown file.

verificationEvidence.command: node inline root inventory + target strict checker
verificationEvidence.note: Fresh strict checker plus reviewer feedback confirms README.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md stay root; CHANGELOG.md and KOALA.md remain root compatibility assets.

verificationEvidence.command: rg Scope Boundary Audit + final Claude/Codex audits
verificationEvidence.note: Scope Boundary Audit remains explicit: no bulk move, no root file move/delete, no Production Safety/runtime/global capability claim. Final Claude/Codex read-only audits passed.

items.title: Write the migration guide and upgrade instructions
items.context: Add a small document under docs/requirements/decisions or docs/guide that explains recommended locations, filename mapping, migration order, compatibility/redirect strategy, and reference update rules. It must not claim that migration is complete unless files are actually moved.
items.userSees: The migration guide explains destination mapping, migration order, compatibility redirect strategy, and reference update checks for future root-doc moves.

happy.desc: Guide provides destination mapping plus stepwise migration and upgrade instructions for root documents that should leave root.

edge.desc: Existing target docs or overlapping decisions must be merged or cross-linked before a move, avoiding duplicate truth sources.

adversarial.desc: Guide explicitly forbids claiming a migration is complete or production-grade unless files were actually moved and references validated.

verificationEvidence.command: node inline root inventory + NAV + target strict checker
verificationEvidence.note: Fresh strict checker passed with multiChoiceCount=0 and invalidFutureCount=0; guide provides concrete target-home mapping or explicit TBD/do-not-migrate state plus migration/reference sections.
Fresh NAV check passed: decisionFiles=36, navLinks=36, navCount=36, missingNav=[], staleNav=[]; root-document guide and existing Layer 2 decision are discoverable.

verificationEvidence.command: git diff --check HEAD~1..HEAD + final Claude/Codex audits
verificationEvidence.note: Fresh diff check passed; guide says future moves require dedicated stories and does not claim migration complete, production-grade status, or authority readiness.

items.title: Publish a visible scope-boundary audit note
items.context: Add or include in the migration guide a short audit note that readers can inspect: it must name the known root documents, state which files stay at root, state that no bulk move was performed in this story, and explicitly say the guide does not unlock Production Safety or global capability claims.
items.userSees: The migration guide includes a visible audit note listing known root docs, stay-root files, no bulk move, and no Production Safety or global capability unlock claim.

happy.desc: Audit note names the known root docs, names stay-root files, and states this story only adds the guide and NAV entry.

edge.desc: Audit note distinguishes host-neutral entrypoints from requirements truth-source docs so Claude, Codex, and human host access remains consistent.

adversarial.desc: Audit note explicitly says the guide does not unlock Production Safety, authority or unattended readiness, or global capability claims.

verificationEvidence.command: rg 'Scope Boundary Audit|No bulk move|No root Markdown file' docs/requirements/decisions/root-document-migration-guide.md
verificationEvidence.note: Scope Boundary Audit remains visible and states no bulk move, no root Markdown rename/move/delete, and documentation-only behavior.

verificationEvidence.command: claude final host-neutral audit B + node strict checker
verificationEvidence.note: Host-neutral audit PASS and strict checker PASS: entrypoints, compatibility assets, existing decisions, and future-only targets are distinguished without mixing truth-source layers.

verificationEvidence.command: rg 'does not unlock Production Safety|does not assert unattended readiness|does not claim any new global capability' docs/requirements/decisions/root-document-migration-guide.md
verificationEvidence.note: Scope Boundary Audit explicitly denies Production Safety unlock, authority/unattended readiness, and global capability claims; future Layer4 row is marked Future-only and no-unlock.
